awsImported: "{label}" was imported and fetches its credentials from AWS Secrets Manager (secret "{secretId}"){where}. Open it with Edit, check where it connects, and Save it before connecting.
sshImported: "{label}" was imported and connects through an SSH tunnel{where}, signing in with your own SSH key. Open it with Edit, check where it connects, and Save it before connecting.
notSnoutSignIn: This connection does not sign in with your SnoutData account.
snoutSignInUnavailable: This connection signs in with your SnoutData account, which is not available yet.
noPipeline: This connection runs SQL directly, so there is no pipeline translation.
readOnlyWrites: Connection "{label}" is read-only; this query writes data and is blocked.
readOnlyLoad: Connection "{label}" is read-only; loading a file into it is blocked.
syncGone: Source or target connection no longer exists.
syncAcross: Cannot sync across database types ("{driver}" → "{targetDriver}"). Source and target must use the same driver.
readOnlySync: Connection "{label}" is read-only; Schema Sync cannot change its schema.
componentConnect: This database needs a one-time component download ({totalLabel}). Click Connect to install it.
notSupportedOs: This database isn't supported on your operating system yet.
componentSave: This database needs a one-time component download ({totalLabel}). Save the connection and click Connect to install it.
similarityNeedsEmbed: Similarity search needs an embeddings model, which this build has no access to yet.
cloudAccountGone: The cloud account this connection uses no longer exists. Edit the connection and pick one, or add it again in Settings.
